extracted_graph.step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture transcribes Age of Learning's CI/CD build infrastructure on Amazon EKS. A dedicated Base Node Group in Private Subnet A hosts GitLab Runners (Runner Unity and Runner Perf). Dynamic Worker Node Groups span across Private Subnets A, B, and C to execute GitLab Job pods on large spot instances (16xlarge and metal). An Amazon S3 bucket acts as a centralized cache and artifact store connected via a VPC endpoint, accelerating build times by 50-60%. The core workflow shows GitLab Runner Perf checking S3 for cache, pulling artifacts, spawning a GitLab Job pod in Subnet B, which uploads updated build outputs back to S3 upon completion and reports status back to the runner.
